report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with HIV 5 years ago, reports inconsistent medication adherence with breaks taken when feeling well. Experiences headaches and fatigue when off medication, which 'throw me off balance' and remind them of how much the illness affects daily life. Describes living with HIV as a constant balancing act between hope and fear, optimism and worry. Has emotional hurt about how HIV was acquired from a partner who didn't disclose status. Struggles to understand treatment regimen details and keeps track of everything. Trusts medical team but feels sometimes pushed for more aggressive treatment than comfortable. Considers medication the 'best bet' for control but has nagging doubt about whether it's essential.
